instruction.text: Find the rich man to learn more.

feedback.end: The Victorian Era was a period of time in English history from 1837 to 1901. Before the Victorian Era, education was only accessible to rich boys.

instruction.text: Select the picture of a factory.

feedback.end: During the Victorian Era, Britain led the world in industry. To stay ahead, people needed to be clever and skilled, so the government decided that more children needed to go to school.

instruction.text: Listen and select the correct end to the sentence.

b.sound: aimed to give an education to all children aged 5-12.
banned all children from going to school.

atoms.a: However, children did not have to go to school, ...

b.sound: so lots of them kept working instead.
so lots of them destroyed all the schools.
all children aged 5-10 'had' to go to school.
they did not care about children.

feedback.end: By making school compulsory for all children, the 1880 Education Act also allowed girls and poor children to be educated.

instruction.text: Drag the labels to the correct parts of the Victorian classroom.

feedback.end: In the Victorian Era, classrooms looked very gloomy! Pupils learnt to write on pieces of stone called slate. Older pupils would write using dipping pens that they would dip into an ink pot on their desk.
In Victorian schools, pupils would learn by copying down words and sentences from the blackboard.

instruction.text: Select the three subjects that Victorian pupils studied in school.

end.text: In the Victorian Era, maths was called arithmetic. Reading, writing and arithmetic were known as the “three Rs”.
end.sound: In the Victorian Era, maths was called arithmetic. Reeding, writing, and arithmetic were known as the three Rs.

atoms.b: Victorian schools were very ((++strict silly)). If a pupil misbehaved, they were ((++punished loved)).
If a pupil did not pay attention or did not ((++work scream)) very hard, they would have to sit in a corner and wear a dunce hat. “Dunce” is a ((++mean kind)) word that means stupid person.
atoms.sound: If a pupil did not pay attention or did not work very hard, they would have to sit in a corner and wear a dunce hat. Dunce is a mean word that means stupid person.

atoms.b: The worst punishment in Victorian schools was the cane. The teacher would ((++hit sing)) the pupil on their hands or legs with a wooden stick.
